description.value: The caster emulates a bomb to explode, dealing 1d6 points of half fire/bludgeoning damage per level to everything (except the caster) within a 5-ft.-radius burst + 5 feet per level. As an additional cost to cast this spell, the caster’s HP is set to -1 (and bleeding). In addition, you are unable to cast this spell if you attempt to cast it while already at -1 or lower HP. Learned From Bomb Family
